title: Find your squad.
lead: Whenever you want to play. Post a party or join one in seconds, with people who play like you.

parties.name: Clear parties
parties.title: Every party tells you what you need
parties.body: Game, platform, spots, mic, skill level, language and time. Tap “I want to play” and you’re in the group chat.

compatible.name: Compatible with you
compatible.title: Players who fit you
compatible.body: We suggest players based on your schedule, platforms, languages and how you like to play. Your preferences stay private.

steam.name: Steam
steam.title: Connect your Steam
steam.body: Log in with your Steam account, see what your squad is playing and, if they allow it, join their lobby.

community.name: Community
community.title: A community in your language
community.body: Player-written guides, gaming news, friends and chats, all in Spanish.
